records.name: The  Weighing  Scales
records.credit: British Library, HMNTS 10270.g.3 (identifier 000266582); engraving by Victor Dedoncker
records.source_observation: The 1878 volume captions this exact facade Maison de la Balance, rue de la Colline; the source image is an engraving rather than a photograph and has no reviewer change label.
records.identity_note: The City dataset labels this case The Weighing Scales, Grand-Place 24. Heritage inventory Urban 30991 labels La Balance, Rue de la Colline 24, while explicitly treating its facade as part of the Grand-Place ensemble. The British Library caption uses rue de la Colline; Wikimedia Commons describes Grand-Place and supplies protected-monument identifier 2043-0177/0. The City and heritage records share the distinctive 1704, 1890 and 1986 chronology, but the street-address mapping still requires reviewer confirmation.
records.facade_observation: The 1878 engraving and 2011 photograph show a strongly matching facade composition: central stepped/gabled upper section, vertical pilasters, sculpted figures, and balcony. Same facade composition visibly persists; detail-level changes are not assessed. This is facade evidence only and does not establish structural age.
